hero.title: Design your outfit, then have it made.
hero.description: Pick the garment, the styles and the fabric, and the studio draws your design. When it looks right, send it to tailors and choose the quote you like.

refine.title: Change anything until it's right
refine.description: Type what you'd change and the studio makes a new version. Every version is kept, so you can compare them and go back.
points: Refine with a few words, like "longer sleeves"
See the back of your design too

request.title: Send it to up to five tailors
request.description: We suggest tailors who suit the design and say why. Each one replies with a price and a delivery time. You only pay when you accept one.
points: Tailors see the version on screen, front and back
Track every quote under My Designs

quotes.title: Compare quotes, then pay a deposit
quotes.description: Each quote shows the price, what the fabric costs and when it will be ready. Accept one and pay half now, plus delivery.
points: Fabric cost shown before you accept
Pay from your wallet or by card
The rest only when your outfit is finished

finished.title: See it finished before you pay the rest
finished.description: Your tailor sends photos of the finished piece. Pay the balance to approve it and they ship it, or ask them to adjust something first.
points: Ask for changes before it ships
A chat with your tailor the whole way

closing.title: Design it once. Have it made by a tailor you choose.
closing.description: Join the waitlist to be among the first to design in the studio.
